detailZones.title: Book stacks
detailZones.description: Inspect shelving structure, arranged volumes, display hardware and a mobile return trolley.

detailZones.title: Circulation and self-service
detailZones.description: Explore the service desk, book return, staff hardware, return cart and self-checkout kiosk.

detailZones.title: Reading and study area
detailZones.description: Inspect reading furniture, study dividers, lighting and personal study objects.

detailZones.title: Children and media area
detailZones.description: Explore low book displays, story furniture, media hardware and map storage.

detailZones.title: Entrance and safety fixtures
detailZones.description: Inspect the glazed entrance, ceiling services, clock, emergency fixtures and windows.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 library photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It supports visible shelving, books, service and self-check hardware, reading furniture, children's displays, media equipment, map storage and entrance fixtures. Catalog records, loans, classifications, subjects, patrons, staff roles and other invisible library operations are excluded.
